audit.why: TRICKY at 7/10 fits 53.3% over 1334 games — she owns levels 1-5 on a one-rotation kill threat, and loses everything after Riftwalk exists.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged the chart against the data, and the two layers disagreed on rows 4, 5 and 6.
audit.why: Full read Skill/Skill/Skill for levels 6, first item and 2+ items while content read LeBlanc/Kassadin/Kassadin. Level 6 is genuinely even — Mimic doubles her burst the same turn Riftwalk arrives — and from first item Void Stone plus a Q shield eats a rotation that is entirely magic.
audit.corrected: Row 4 to Skill in content, rows 5-6 to Kassadin in full, one atomic group with whys matched.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page opened with 'AD assassins skip your shield' and never stated the decisive interaction on Ethereal Chains.
audit.why: Every LeBlanc ability deals magic damage, so Void Stone's magic reduction and the Q shield are the two things that actually work here. And Riot's E text is explicit: the shackle only becomes a root if the target 'remains shackled for 1.5 seconds' — breaking range or line of sight inside that window denies the root and the whole combo behind it.
audit.corrected: Magic framing restored; the 1.5-second shackle window stated wherever a step-up is described.
Distortion 15s to 10s with a 4-second return window; Sigil of Malice a flat 6s; Ethereal Chains 14s to 11s; Mimic 45/35/25s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mirror Image was never mentioned anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: below 40% Health she turns invisible for 1 second and spawns a damage-free clone for up to 8 seconds. That is exactly the HP band where a Kassadin commits his blink, and Kassadin has no reveal in his kit.
audit.corrected: Added to the late-game text and to the Don'ts.

notes: CHART: the packet flagged the chart against the data (Kassadin wins 53.3% but LeBlanc held 5 of 7 stages), and the layers disagreed on rows 4-6 — full read Skill three times while content read LeBlanc/Kassadin/Kassadin. Resolved as one atomic group: win[4] to Skill (full already Skill), phases[5..6].side to Kassadin (content already Kassadin), whys and phases[N].why rewritten on both sides to match. Result LeBlanc x4, Skill, Kassadin, Kassadin with no cross-layer disagreement left. FACT ERROR SHIPPED: the tldr and report[0] called LeBlanc an 'AD assassin' whose damage 'skips your shield'. Every ability in her kit deals magic damage, so Void Stone and the Q shield are the two things that DO work — the page told the reader the opposite of the truth on the most-read line of the matchup. Also newly stated: Ethereal Chains only roots if the shackle survives a full 1.5 seconds (Riot's own E text), and Mirror Image triggers under 40% HP with a 1-second invisibility plus an 8-second clone, which was absent from the entire page. The brief's missingInteraction claims LeBlanc can 'cancel your Null Sphere' — Null Sphere is not a channel in Riot's text, only a cast, so I wrote the ordinary CC advice (do not cast while shackled) rather than asserting a channel interaction.
